highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release improves packaged documentation and keeps generated bindings aligned with bundled native libraries.
highlights_body: NuGet packages now include XML documentation sidecars, while the P/Invoke and HarfBuzz binding generation pipelines are reorganized for more reliable maintenance.

bullets.lead: XML documentation ships with NuGet packages
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp packages now include XML documentation sidecars so IDEs can show API documentation directly from the installed package.
P/Invoke bindings are organized by native type, and HarfBuzz bindings are generated from the same pinned source revision used for the bundled native library.
